(defn cost [key]
  (let [prices (get (state) "prices")
        cents (reduce + 0 (map (fn [c] (* (/ (get c "tokens") 1000.0) (get prices (get c "model") 0)))
                               (filter (fn [c] (= (get c "key") key)) (get (state) "calls"))))]
    (/ (round cents) 100)))

(defn set_quota [key tokens]
  (when (> (usage key) tokens) (throw (ex-info "already over that quota" {})))
  (swap-state! assoc-in ["quotas" key] tokens)
  tokens)

(defn record_usage [key model tokens]
  (when-not (and (string? key) (not= key "")) (throw (ex-info "key required" {})))
  (when-not (and (string? model) (not= model "")) (throw (ex-info "model required" {})))
  (when-not (and (integer? tokens) (pos? tokens)) (throw (ex-info "tokens must be a positive whole number" {})))
  (let [quota (get-in (state) ["quotas" key])]
    (when (and quota (> (+ (usage key) tokens) quota)) (throw (ex-info "over quota" {}))))
  (swap-state! update "calls" (fnil conj []) {"key" key "model" model "tokens" tokens})
  (usage key))

(defn top_spender []
  (reduce (fn [best k] (if (or (nil? best) (> (cost k) (cost best))) k best))
          nil (sort (distinct (map (fn [c] (get c "key")) (get (state) "calls"))))))
